Definition: Eliphelet or Elpelet, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eliphelet or Elpelet is the name of six Israelites. The name appears in 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eliphelet or Elpelet matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
